name.value: All Of Oils, Wholesome Oils & Vinegars

description.value: All Of Oils is a Fraser Valley specialty retailer focused on extra virgin olive oils, flavoured balsamic vinegars, and gourmet foods, operating two tasting-room locations in South Surrey and Langley. Their EVOOs are imported twice yearly from growers across multiple hemispheres, with full chemistry and tasting-panel data displayed for every product. In-store samplings are available, and the shop offers custom corporate gifting and olive oil tasting events.
